scope: Fitness Browser organisms downloaded before the scientific audit
development_basis: Archived model and protocol development used fitness observations, prediction errors or benchmark scores from these organisms. Exact exposure is not restricted to the currently accepted patch list.
quarantine_basis: Prior phenotype inspection is undocumented. This sprint did not inspect their phenotype file contents; they are not claimed as held-out or independent data.
interpretation: This is a conservative exposure declaration, not an access log or proof of non-exposure. A prospective external evaluation requires a separate documented custodian and protocol.
